issues.issue: Did the claimants ask the Appeal Division for a full de novo hearing, so they can challenge its failure to hold one?
issues.applicant_position: Minister: claimants never requested a de novo hearing, so they cannot raise its absence on judicial review.
issues.respondent_position: Claimants: they did raise the de novo hearing before the Appeal Division.
issues.result_quote: These facts are inconsistent with the submission that the respondents sought a full de novo hearing

issues.issue: Was the de novo hearing issue properly before the Federal Court, given the claimants' argument that the Minister raised it for the first time on appeal?
issues.applicant_position: Minister: the de novo issue was properly before the court; it was not raised in the leave application.
issues.respondent_position: Claimants: the Minister is improperly raising, for the first time on appeal, that the de novo issue was not properly before the Federal Court.
issues.result_quote: There is no merit in this submission because the issue was not raised in the respondents’ application for leave

issues.issue: Should the court answer the certified question on the deference the RAD owes to RPD credibility findings?
issues.result_quote: I would decline to answer the certified question because the issue of a full de novo hearing
